result:
Root cause: `updateTerminal`'s no-legal-moves branch (`variants/bug07/movegen.inc`) called `moverInCheck` — which ignores its argument and asks whether the side that just *moved* is in check, always false after a legal move — instead of `inCheckSide` on the side to move, so every checkmate fell through to the stalemate branch.

Files touched:
- `variants/bug07/`: `movegen.inc` (the one-instruction fix), `Makefile` (`SRC` was missing three includes), `BUILD.md`
- `contract/`: `spec/Contract.lean` (+T4c/T4d/T5c, semantics unchanged), `bridge/b1_witnesses.py`, `bridge/b2_mutations.py`, `bridge/emu.py`, `bridge/b4_perft_cross.py`, `bridge/b5_emulator_oracle.py`, `bridge/b7_findings.py`, `bridge/b8_terminal_oracle.py` (new), `bridge/b9_build_identity.sh` (new), `bridge/run_all.sh`, `SUMMARY.md`, `DECISIONS.md`, `organic_findings.md`
- root: `FIX_NOTES.md`, `STATE.md`

The rebuilt `chess.tap` is byte-identical (md5 783b72ba018897b1311a7af0295ab041) to the pre-registered pristine `contract/artifacts/chess.tap`; pre-fix the images differed in exactly one code byte, so the fix is provably the whole fault.

Gate status:
- Reported symptom no longer reproduces — PASS. All five report cases correct including screen text (`Checkmate! White wins`, `Checkmate! Black wins`, `Stalemate - draw`, `Your move`).
- `variants/bug07/make test` — PASS, 5/5.
- Bridge — PASS, `GATE: GREEN (13/13 layers)`, 5m43s. b8 9 runs / 104 checks; b5 9 runs / 72 checks; b4 now boots the engine live (410,082 nodes) instead of replaying a recording; b9 verifies the tape reproduces from source.
- Fault class pinned — PASS. Engine regression trips b5 + b8 (E3/E4/E5 on five mate rows); spec/twin regression trips b0/b1/b2; source-not-rebuilt trips b9. Each verified red-on-fault by mutation, independently by all three reviewers.
- Attack round — closed at the 3-round hard cap, not by a clean round. Each round found blocking findings: R1 b4 replayed a recording and a false pinning claim in FIX_NOTES; R2 b7 read a hardcoded absolute path; R3 the gate never rebuilt the tape from source, and no layer read the status line so the report's literal symptom could recur with the gate green. All repaired and verified. Round-3's repairs (b9, b8's E5, the two fifty-move precedence rows, findings F12/F13) have not themselves been adversarially reviewed — recorded in `FIX_NOTES.md` §5.3 and in `SUMMARY.md`'s residuals.

- `movegen.inc`'s `utPlay` can take the same predicate substitution with the gate green — the `Check!` message it sets is never actually displayed (`mainLoop` overwrites it), so there is no observable to test against.
- b8 has no castling / promotion / en-passant / discovered-mate row; the castling-rights and non-default-depth paths of `run_fen`/`fen_pos` are unexercised; E2 is empty-vs-empty on mate rows.
- `contract/smt/s1..s3` hardcode `~/.venvs/quant/.../python3.14/site-packages` — toolchain-pointing and fail-loud, so left alone; D-TAP-1's wording was narrowed rather than overclaiming.
- F12 (a loaded or edited position never gets a terminal verdict) and F13 (the engine logs a phantom move when handed a position with no move) are recorded as organic findings, not repaired — both are outside the reported bug and outside contract scope.
